CURRENTLY TRACKING: S howers and thunderstorms continue through Thursday morning with dry but less humid conditions on Friday. Heat and humidity return this weekend. NEXT 24HRS: THURSDAY: Showers or periods of light rain continue through the AM commute, with most of the activity along and south of I-90. Partial clearing is expected during the afternoon under less humid conditions. Temperatures climb into the low to mid-80s with a light northwest wind. THURSDAY NIGHT: Partly cloudy to mostly clear skies are expected, with patchy fog possible near sunrise on Friday. LOOKIN G AHEAD - 8 THINGS TO KNOW ​COPYRIGHT 2025 BY NEWS 8 NOW/NEWS 8000.
